headline: Pennar Industries updates the corporate office address of its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent.
hook: New contact address for Pennar's transfer agent
summary: Pennar Industries has officially notified the stock exchange about a change in the physical corporate office address of its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RSTA). This is a routine administrative update regarding shareholder services and documentation routing. No direct financial impact or operational changes are associated with this filing for investors.
why_it_matters: Zero impact on share price or company fundamentals.

headline: Pennar Industries informs exchanges of credit rating action
hook: Routine credit rating update for Pennar Industries
summary: Pennar Industries Limited has officially notified the stock exchanges regarding a credit rating update. The filing provides compliance updates on the company's existing credit facilities. Further details on the specific rating agencies or rating revisions were not detailed in the brief initial notice. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review upcoming detailed rating reports when available.
why_it_matters: Credit rating updates help assess the debt risk of your holdings.
